_comment: CANDIDATE Stoa enforcement-hook registration block — NOT auto-merged into any live settings.json. install.sh deploys this file to <DEST>/.claude/templates/settings-hooks.json as a candidate ONLY. Merging it into a live .claude/settings.json ARMS the hooks, which gate real tool calls in that session; that is an explicit operator-gated step (install.sh --enable-hooks, DEFAULT OFF) that even when used targets the INSTALL TARGET, never the running build session. HARD SAFETY CONSTRAINT (design-rev1 section 8): no Stoa arc auto-writes a live settings.json. The HOOKS_DIR placeholder slot in each command path is sed-substituted at deploy time to the deployed .claude/hooks absolute path. The 'if' fields use permission-rule syntax to narrow which commands invoke each gate (the gate script then inspects tool_input.command to build its self-contained deny message). All gates FAIL-OPEN on script error.
